Thesis.proseOnly: The thesis frames serving as admission control under recurring cost; prose carries the argument.

The Serving Tax.proseOnly: The serving-tax equation and TTFT/TPOT distinction carry the mechanism.

Serving Cost Dominance.proseOnly: The first-year cost chart carries the quantitative comparison.

Workloads Do Not Share One Bottleneck.proseOnly: The workload contrast is a taxonomy argument clearer in prose than in a single figure.

Batching Trades Waiting for Reuse.teaches: Static membership leaves completed rows padded while continuous batching admits replacement work at iteration boundaries. The visual makes the recovered slots concrete without implying the gain is unconditional.
Batching Trades Waiting for Reuse.source: Book continuous-batching diagram and padding-waste scenario; redrawn to contrast fixed membership with replacement admission directly.

KV Cache Is the Real Batch Limit.teaches: Long-context KV state converts admission into a memory budget: twelve 128K requests can exhaust an eight-H100 node's KV pool even after GQA. Paging recovers fragmentation but cannot shrink tensor payload.
KV Cache Is the Real Batch Limit.source: Book KV-capacity estimator and ladder figure; redrawn as a budget bar plus admission blocks.

Prefill and Decode Are Different Machine.teaches: Prefill is one wide compute-oriented pass while decode is a chain of narrow bandwidth-oriented steps. Disaggregation separates the lanes but pays a KV handoff.
Prefill and Decode Are Different Machine.source: Book prefill/decode roofline, chunked-prefill and disaggregated-serving figures; redrawn as a simplified two-lane timing diagram.

Sharding and Routing Are Capacity Decisi.teaches: Fan-out makes the slowest leaf dominate the assembled request; one percent slow leaves at fan-out 100 produce about 63 percent slow requests.
Sharding and Routing Are Capacity Decisi.source: Book tail-latency fan-out analysis; redrawn as a request fan-out diagram with the inversion budget.

Capacity Control Completes the System.proseOnly: Autoscaling, warm pools, multi-tenancy and spot capacity are policy tradeoffs carried by prose.
